title: High-dimensional layer-state trajectories reveal the internal dynamics of transformer inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.26866v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mechanistic studies of large language models localize function in parameters, attention heads or neurons, but those parts do not specify how one inference unfolds. We treat the ordered layer-state trajectory as the empirical process and test whether layer order defines a measurable computation. Across representative Qwen, Llama and Gemma checkpoints, realized order produced paths 1.60--2.24 times as aligned with their endpoint chord as endpoint-preserving shuffles. The order effect transferred to a lexical task, but was stronger in three random initializations of the same Qwen architecture, identifying an architecture-compatible scaffold rather than a training-specific law. Direct hidden states provided stronger mechanism coordinates than vocabulary readbacks, and a task-defined coordinate made candidate competition computable. After additive interventions failed, local transition actuators selectively controlled internal trajectories

translated_title: 高维层状态轨迹揭示Transformer推理的内部动力学
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的机制研究将功能定位于参数、注意力头或神经元之中，但这些部件并不能说明一次推理是如何逐步展开的。我们将有序的层状态轨迹视为经验过程，并检验层顺序是否定义了一种可测量的计算。在代表性的Qwen、Llama和Gemma检查点上，实际实现的层顺序所产生的路径与其终点弦的对齐程度是保持终点的随机打乱顺序的1.60至2.24倍。这种顺序效应可以迁移到词汇任务中，但在同一Qwen架构的三个随机初始化模型中表现更强，这表明它是一种与架构兼容的支架结构，而非训练特有的规律。直接隐藏状态比词汇回读提供了更强的机制坐标，而任务定义的坐标使得候选词之间的竞争变得可计算。在加性干预失败之后，局部转换执行器能够选择性地控制内部轨迹。
tldr: 该研究将Transformer逐层推理的有序层状态轨迹作为经验对象，发现真实层顺序产生的轨迹对齐度是保持终点随机打乱的1.60至2.24倍，证明层顺序构成一种与架构兼容而非训练特有的可测量计算，并可通过局部转换执行器实现对内部推理轨迹的选择性控制。
en_tdlr: By treating ordered layer-state trajectories as the empirical process of inference, this study shows that realized layer order yields paths 1.60–2.24 times more aligned with their endpoint chord than endpoint-preserving shuffles—an architecture-compatible scaffold rather than a training-specific law—and demonstrates that local transition actuators can selectively control internal inference trajectories.
